AZRAEL is an indies music game with nurturing elements. Through simple and straightforward operations, anyone can enjoy the fun by playing. The game includes tracks created by artists from all over the world, as well as exquisite seal paintings drawn by illustrators. Each piece of music has produced a key tone score, which can bring players the immersive experience like playing their own music.

【Background story】
AZRAEL is a new clinical trial system of psychotherapy, which establishes links with patients with mental illness and help them open their hearts with music and fight the demon within. 

In the game, players will be a psychologist who is the initiator of AZRAEL, use music experimental therapy to treat the patients who is voluntary involved. But behind this seemingly simple purpose, there are some hidden secrets.

【Content】
Click, press, slide and other simple moves, tap the screen along with the melody to play it!
Classical falling mode and innovative two side falling mode will bring you the brand new feeling and immersive experience.

In the game, players can interact with many characters with different personalities to deepen the fetters and explore their inner stories. You can also change a variety of costumes for characters, equip them with a variety of props, challenge different ways of playing, and find new fun.

The game will continue to add music tracks, character costumes and new story chapters.
